newsitem.title: GERMANY: Goldman ups EPS estimates for big German banks.
newsitem.headline: Goldman ups EPS estimates for big German banks.

text.p: Goldman Sachs said on Friday it had raised its earnings per share estimates for Germany's top three commercial banks Deutsche Bank AG, Dresdner Bank AG and Commerzbank AG.
"We're continuing to see better than expected core earnings growth at the big banks," said Neil Crowder, banking analyst at Goldman Sachs.

Goldman has raised its estimate for Deutsche's net income per share in 1998 to 5.37 marks ($3.11) from an earlier estimate of 5.27 marks. Its 1997 estimate remains unchanged at 4.84 marks, up from 4.25 marks in 1996.
Crowder also said Goldman had raised its earnings estimate for Dresdner Bank in both 1997 and 1998.
